stage0016_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「All right, everyone...!
　Let's begin the exercise as briefed」

stage0016_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「We're the Earth Federation Forces.
　Under that name, Earthnoid or Spacenoid doesn't matter!
　Let's hit it hard!」

stage0016_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
Neo Zeon Soldier
「Earthnoids are the colony's enemy!」

stage0016_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Wh-what are you two saying!?」

stage0016_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
Neo Zeon Soldier
「We have no choice!」

stage0016_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
Federation Soldier
「You'll pay for that, you Zeon scum!」

stage0016_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
Neo Zeon Soldier
「You Federation dogs, how dare you!」

stage0016_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Stop it, both of you!
　Just stop it!」

stage0016_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
Neo Zeon Soldier
「If you're getting in the way...!」

stage0016_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Let's get back into position,
　Patrick $$コーラサワー$$!」

stage0016_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$グラハム$$
「For now, call me $$プリベンター$$ Lightning」

stage0016_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That voice... I feel like I've heard it before...
　You knew my name, so are we acquainted?」

stage0016_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Heh... A former AEU ace,
　there's no one in the military who hasn't
　heard the name of the Undying $$コーラサワー$$」

stage0016_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Heh... That's ancient history.
　These days, I'm Happy $$パトリック・マネキン$$」

stage0016_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「But I'm still an ace, no matter what!」

stage0016_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Lend me a hand, Lightning!
　I don't get what's going on, but I'm the
　exercise commander, so I've got to stop them!」

stage0016_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「The independent unit, Londo Bell!」

stage0016_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$レイアム$$
「It looks like the units taking part
　in the exercise have split into two and are fighting」

stage0016_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ブライト$$
「So my bad feeling was right after all...!」

stage0016_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$グラハム$$
「This is $$プリベンター$$ Lightning.
　Unfortunately, we couldn't avoid a fight
　between the Earth side and the colony side」

stage0016_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Right now, to confirm the situation,
　we're neutralizing both sides」

stage0016_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
Bright
「This is Londo Bell's commander, Colonel $$ブライト・ノア$$.
　We'll assist you and put this down swiftly」

stage0016_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$シン$$
「Looks like $$ヒイロ$$ and $n aren't here...」

stage0016_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$カツ$$
「Then what in the world did those two
　go on ahead for!?」

stage0016_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's about $$ヒイロ$$ and the others.
　I'm sure they've got something in mind」

stage0016_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$リディ$$
「Let's go, everyone!
　We'll carry out our own mission!」

stage0016_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$バナージ$$, don't push yourself too hard.
　First, think about surviving yourself」

stage0016_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't think that someone who can't protect
　their own life can protect anyone else」

stage0016_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$!
　Analysis of the NT-D activation conditions isn't done!」

stage0016_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Figuring that out is your job too, remember!」

stage0016_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, begin the attack!
　Don't hit the cockpits!」

stage0016_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ブライト$$
「To avoid any needless casualties,
　we'll hold them down ourselves as best we can!」

stage0016_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
???
「We planned to move during the Federation's
　exercise, but we'll change the plan」

stage0016_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
???
「Let's have Londo Bell play that role instead」

stage0016_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$オットー$$
「Looks like it's finally settled down...」

stage0016_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Why did it have to come to this...」

stage0016_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ブライト$$
「You're Lieutenant $$パトリック・マネキン$$,
　the officer in charge on-site for this exercise.
　Tell me everything you know」

stage0016_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Even I don't understand it myself」

stage0016_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「It's true those two seemed to be
　at odds with each other deep down, but
　they never forgot their duty as soldiers」

stage0016_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Feelings are feelings, duty is duty,
　they should've handled the exercise properly...」

stage0016_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$メラン$$
「Same as the other cases, then」

stage0016_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ブライト$$
「So we've got no leads, then...」

stage0016_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$オットー$$
「What should we do, Commander $$ブライト$$?」

stage0016_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I want to check the details before and after.
　Let's head into Colony X-18999 first」

stage0016_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain!
　Something's coming out of X-18999!」

stage0016_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$オットー$$
「What!?
　The defense unit should be out on exercise!」

stage0016_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's the new model $$トロワ$$ was piloting...!」

stage0016_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$リディ$$
「To think they assembled that many!」

stage0016_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Can you hear me, Londo Bell?」

stage0016_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$メラン$$
「Commander!
　It's a transmission from that group's shuttle!」

stage0016_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ブライト$$
「That voice... it's still a child...!」

stage0016_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
Mariemaia
「I am $$マリーメイア・クシュリナーダ$$.
　As the rightful heir to $$ＡＤＷ$$'s ruler in this new
　world, I declare Colony X-18999's independence, and...」

stage0016_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「I hereby declare war on the Earth Federation」

stage0016_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Does she have some tie to $$トレーズ$$ Khushrenada...!?」

stage0016_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Some of you may recognize my name.
　As you may guess, I am the daughter of $$トレーズ$$
　Khushrenada, who led the Earth Federation of $$ＡＤＷ$$」

stage0016_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「In my father's ideals, I condemn the current
　state of the Earth Federation, and as $$ＡＤＷ$$'s
　representative, vow to become this new world's hope」

stage0016_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「So it was them who attacked the colony!」

stage0016_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Against us, who called for independence,
　you chose to crush us by force...
　and as a result, X-18999 collapses. That's the script」

stage0016_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$エマ$$
「They'd destroy a colony with their own hands...!」

stage0016_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$シン$$
「You don't care about the residents' lives at all!」

stage0016_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「The residents of X-18999
　will become noble sacrifices for a new era」

stage0016_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Originally, the role of destroying X-18999
　was meant for the defense unit stationed
　at that colony, but I've changed the casting」

stage0016_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「The Earth Federation's violent rule
　will light the colony residents' discontent,
　and it will become a blaze engulfing the world」

stage0016_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$リディ$$
「You think this nonsense will fly!?」

stage0016_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「It's results that move the world.
　The fact of a colony's collapse will push tension
　between Earth and space to a new level」

stage0016_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$デキム$$
「Lady $$マリーメイア$$...
　it's about time to depart」

stage0016_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Well then, farewell, Londo Bell.
　You, who destroyed the colony,
　will be brought down by our hands. That's the ending」

stage0016_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$デキム$$
「$$サーペント$$ Squad,
　begin your attack on the colony's control center!」

stage0016_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Lightning!
　Who's piloting that thing!?」

stage0016_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$グラハム$$
「That name is the wind that smothers fires...
　$$プリベンター$$ Wind...」

stage0016_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「I stayed hidden in case of emergencies,
　and it seems my hunch was right.
　A man who can't settle into peace still has his uses」

stage0016_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$デキム$$
「You... you were alive after all...!」

stage0016_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「I was dead.
　But as long as $$トレーズ$$'s ghost wanders about,
　I can't just lie quietly asleep in my coffin」

stage0016_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$デキム・バートン$$,
　I was told about you by Cairns
　of《$$ホワイトファング$$》」

stage0016_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$デキム$$
「$$サーペント$$ Squad, move forward!
　Strike down $$ゼクス$$ and Londo Bell!」

stage0016_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$デキム$$
「I will advance the plan to its next stage
　together with Lady $$マリーメイア$$!」

stage0016_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$シン$$
「Like I'd let you get away!」

stage0016_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Wait, $$シン$$!
　Right now, hit them and save the colony first!」

stage0016_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
Noin
「This is $$プリベンター$$'s $$ルクレツィア・ノイン$$...!
　The colony is trying to extinguish the fire
　and handle the damaged areas from within!」

stage0016_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Leave the colony to $$デュオ$$.
　We'll take down the enemy mobile suits」

stage0016_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Same as ever, it seems, $$ヒイロ$$」

stage0016_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Laugh at us as shameless, if you wish.
　But for now...」

stage0016_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I won't ask about the past.
　Right now, we need your strength too.」

stage0016_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Shaken off the past, have you, $$ゼクス$$?」

stage0016_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The $$アルトロンガンダム$$!」

stage0016_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$シン$$
「$$五飛$$ came to help too!」

stage0016_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$シン$$
「What's the meaning of this, $$五飛$$!」

stage0016_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$スズネ$$
「To think the colony's Gundam pilots
　would split and fight as foes...」

stage0016_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$n
「Unlike $$トロワ$$ the other day,
　he seems to mean it this time...!」

stage0016_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, shoot the enemy down now!
　Stop tactics lower than terrorism, whatever it takes!」

stage0016_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$五飛$$
「Are you in the right...!
　If so, then show me that justice!」

stage0016_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$エマ$$
「Reinforcements from the $$マリーメイア$$ army!?」

stage0016_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$n
「Is that the bat that came with the $$ジェニオン$$!」

stage0016_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But wasn't that thing swept into this world
　by a dimensional tremor accident...!」

stage0016_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$リディ$$
「That Unknown,
　it looks ready to come after us!」

stage0016_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Looks like it's unmanned!
　If hailing's no use, we fight back!」

stage0016_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$五飛$$
「Answer me, $$ヒイロ$$!
　Are you in the right!」

stage0016_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$n
「I'll turn that around!
　Are you in the right!」

stage0016_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$n
「Standing with those who sacrifice
　innocent people, are YOU in the right!」

stage0016_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ノイン$$
「$$ヒルデ$$, how bad is the colony damage...!?」

stage0016_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「It's all right, $$ノイン$$!
　$$デュオ$$ and I made emergency repairs!」

stage0016_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「$$カトル$$ asked me to bring it.
　Said to get it to $$デュオ$$ and the rest.」

stage0016_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$デュオ$$
「$$ヒイロ$$!
　Your Zero's here too!」

stage0016_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$シン$$
「Am I imagining it...?
　It looks pretty different now...」

stage0016_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$五飛$$
「So you've boarded a Gundam, $$ヒイロ$$...!」

stage0016_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I'll say it again.
　Press self-destruct!」

stage0016_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$五飛$$
「Then enough talk!
　I'll beat you and walk my own path!」

stage0016_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$五飛$$
「I won't... end here of all places!」

stage0016_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$メラン$$
「The $$マリーメイア$$ army is withdrawing.」

stage0016_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All that remains is the Unknowns.」

stage0016_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$シン$$
「What is with them...?
　Did they come to back the $$マリーメイア$$ army...?」

stage0016_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$オットー$$
「Somehow, we managed to protect the colony...」

stage0016_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$レイアム$$
「But the $$マリーメイア$$ army's declaration of war
　will affect every front.」

stage0016_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$オットー$$
「...Looks like we're in for busy days again...」

stage0016_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$デュオ$$
「But that $$五飛$$...
　Just when we lost touch with him,
　he'd gone off with people like that...」

stage0016_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$n
「The colony's Gundam pilot, $$張五飛$$...
　What is he even fighting for...」

stage0016_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Let's go, Lightning!
　I'll show them what an Earth Federation
　ace can really do!」

stage0016_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$グラハム$$
「That quick comeback... I should learn from it.」

stage0016_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Now that I've resolved myself, I won't
　look back! I'll carry out my duty, full force!」

stage0016_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$ノイン$$... I'm going to trouble you again.」

stage0016_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ノイン$$
「The greatest trouble to me is you
　leaving without telling me where you're going.」

stage0016_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ノイン$$
「Do you have any idea how many
　sleepless nights I've spent?」

stage0016_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ノイン$$
「I forgive you, $$ゼクス$$.
　For coming back to me, and finding a new fight.」

stage0016_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
Zechs
「Now I have no regrets...!
　I'll fight for the world as $$ゼクス・マーキス$$!」

stage0016_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$五飛$$
「A weaker machine is no excuse, $$ヒイロ$$!
　If you're right, prove it with strength!」

stage0016_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$五飛$$... is this the reason
　you keep piloting a Gundam...!」

stage0016_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$五飛$$
「The fight isn't over yet!
　I'll fight on until the true end comes!」

stage0016_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$五飛$$
「So you've boarded $$ゼロ$$, $$ヒイロ$$!
　Then look to the future!」

stage0016_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$五飛$$
「All that waits in this world is war!
　Admit that much, you too!」

stage0016_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「...If it's a fight you want,
　then I'll fight to stop you...!」

stage0016_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$デュオ$$
「While you were off the grid, you sure
　fell in with a rough crowd, $$五飛$$!」

stage0016_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$五飛$$
「Will you too pretend not to see the world's flaws!」

stage0016_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Don't pick fights with logic that
　makes no sense! This world's not that bad!」

stage0016_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$張五飛$$!
　Are you saying a man like you is haunted
　by $$トレーズ$$'s ghost!」

stage0016_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$五飛$$
「I fight of my own will!
　$$トレーズ$$ has nothing to do with it!」

stage0016_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Wrong, $$五飛$$!
　You and $$トレーズ$$ are alike!」

stage0016_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Harsher than anyone, and kinder than anyone!
　So let me be the one who stops you!」

stage0016_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What are you thinking, $$五飛$$!?
　Why side with terrorists!」

stage0016_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$五飛$$
「Their ideology means nothing to me!
　But this world must keep fighting!」

stage0016_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Do you know how many lives are lost
　to that selfish logic of yours!
　I won't accept anything like that!」

stage0016_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$シン$$
「$$五飛$$!
　What are you doing!?」

stage0016_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$五飛$$
「This is my war with the world!」

stage0016_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$シン$$
「Who even wants this war!
　The world? Or people!?」

stage0016_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$シン$$
「I hate war!
　And whoever creates it too!」

stage0016_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$アムロ$$
「What are you thinking, $$五飛$$!
　You think the $$マリーメイア$$ army's methods
　will save the Spacenoids!?」

stage0016_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$五飛$$
「A soldier like you wouldn't understand!
　The way this world is broken!」

stage0016_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$五飛$$
「That's why I fight!
　For soldiers who've lost their place!」

stage0016_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't think you can save people that way!」

stage0016_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$五飛$$
「An amateur's in that cockpit!
　Don't fight if you don't have to!」

stage0016_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Don't just decide that on your own!
　I have my own reasons to fight!」

stage0016_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$五飛$$
「Then I'll treat you like a warrior!
　Show me your fight!」

stage0016_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$n
「Answer me!
　Why are you starting this fight!」

stage0016_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$五飛$$
「To smash this warped world's false peace!」

stage0016_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$n
「Is it fine to lose lives over that...!
　Do you think those left behind can just
　accept losing someone for a reason like that!」

stage0016_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$n
「I won't accept that!
　Whatever causes senseless death is my enemy!!」

stage0016_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$n
「What are these guys...!?
　Are they backing the $$マリーメイア$$ army...!」

stage0016_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n!
　Focus on defeating the enemy right now!」

stage0016_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$n
「Don't tell me these guys...
　found a route to invade this world!」

stage0016_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$デュオ$$
「There's no turning back now, $$ヒルデ$$!
　Are you ready for this!」

stage0016_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「If I'm with $$デュオ$$...!
　Then so can I!」

stage0016_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Huh? What was that!?
　I couldn't quite hear you!」

stage0016_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「...I said I'm fighting too!
　For peace, colony or Earth, no matter which!」

stage0016_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Got it, $$ヒルデ$$!
　I'll be counting on you!」
